title: Permutation rigidity conjecture for a diagonal stationarity condition
statement:
Let $\Lambda_1\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ and $\Lambda_2\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ be diagonal matrices, with $\Lambda_2\succ0$ having distinct diagonal entries, and let $U\in\mathcal{O}_n$. **Permutation rigidity conjecture.** If

$$
U^\top\Lambda_1^\top\bigl(\Lambda_1U\Lambda_2U^\top\Lambda_1^\top\bigr)^{-1/3}\Lambda_1U
$$

is diagonal, then $U$ is a permutation matrix. This is a technical conjecture used in the proof of the paper's trace-maximization result for the $2/3$ power; the paper does not provide a proof or a resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06134

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2025).
source_name: Veronica Centorrino, Francesco Bullo and Giovanni Russo, “Similarity Matching Networks: Hebbian Learning and Convergence Over Multiple Time Scales”, arXiv:2506.06134 (2025).
